Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:10:1.hebrew: והיתה לו ולזרעו אחריו וגו' - בין זרע פסול — חלל. ולכתחילה לא קאמר, דהא מחולל קרייה רחמנא, שנתחלל מקדושת כהן:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:10:1.english: “And it shall be for him and his seed after him,” etc. - [Both fit seed] and unfit seed — [namely,] a ḥalal. And [the verse] does not say [that he may serve] ab initio, for the Merciful One called him “profaned,” as he has been profaned from the sanctity of a priest.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:11:1.hebrew: חולין שבו - חללין שבו — חללין שבשבט לוי, דקרא בשבט לוי כתיב:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:11:1.english: Profane ones in him - [This means] the ḥalalim [desecrated priests] in him — the ḥalalim of the tribe of Levi, for the verse is written concerning the tribe of Levi.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:13:1.hebrew: ובעל מום דעבודתו פסולה מנלן - אם עבד בשוגג, דאילו במזיד כתיב (ויקרא כ״א:כ״ג) אך אל הפרוכת לא יבא וגו' ולא יחלל את מקדשי. אלא עבד בלא ידיעה — מנלן דלא מכשרינן ליה מהאי קרא דוהיתה לו ולזרעו אחריו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:13:1.english: And a blemished [priest], whose service is invalid, from where do we [derive this] - [This applies] if he served unwittingly; for if [he served] intentionally, it is written: “Only he shall not go in unto the veil... that he profane not My sanctuaries” (Leviticus 21:23). Rather, [if] he served without knowledge [of his blemish] — from where do we [derive] that we do not validate him from this verse: “And it shall be for him and his seed after him” (Numbers 25:13)?

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:13:2.hebrew: הנני נותן לו - לעיל מוהיתה לו כתיב, אלמא בשלימים הוא דאכשר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:13:2.english: Behold, I give to him - It is written prior to “And it shall be to him”; consequently, it is [only] with whole [priests] that [Scripture] validated [the priesthood].

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:14:1.hebrew: כל מקום שיש קידושין ואין עבירה - שהקידושין תופסין בה, ואין עבירה בנשואין, שלא אסרתה תורה עליו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:14:1.english: Any case where there is betrothal and there is no transgression - That the betrothal takes effect with her, and there is no transgression in the marriage, as the Torah did not forbid her to him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:14:2.hebrew: כהנת לויה וישראלית וכו' - לוי שנשא כהנת או ישראלית, בנה לוי; וכהן שנשא לויה וישראלית, בנה כהן; (ולוי) ישראל שנשא כהנת או לויה, הולד ישראל — "למשפחותם לבית אבותם" כתיב:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:14:2.english: The daughter of a priest, the daughter of a Levite, and the daughter of an Israelite, etc. - A Levite who married the daughter of a priest or the daughter of an Israelite, her son is a Levite; and a priest who married the daughter of a Levite or the daughter of an Israelite, her son is a priest; (and a Levite) an Israelite who married the daughter of a priest or the daughter of a Levite, the offspring is an Israelite — [as] it is written: “According to their families, by their fathers’ houses” (Numbers 1:2).

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:15:1.hebrew: אחר הפגום שבשניהם - שנולד מפסולי כהונה, הולד פסול; וכן בן ממזרת לישראל — ממזר; וכן בן ממזר מישראלית — ממזר; וכן בת נתינה לישראל — נתין; ובן נתין מכשרה — נתין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:15:1.english: [Follows] the flawed of the two of them - That [for one] who is born from [those] disqualified to the priesthood, the offspring is disqualified; and similarly, the son of a *mamzeret* with an Israelite [is] a *mamzer*; and similarly, the son of a *mamzer* with an Israelite woman [is] a *mamzer*; and similarly, the daughter of a Gibeonite woman with an Israelite [is] a Gibeonite; and the son of a Gibeonite with a fit [woman] [is] a Gibeonite.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:15:2.hebrew: אלמנה לכ"ג - יש קידושין ויש עבירה, דקסבר: קידושין תופסין בחייבי לאוין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:15:2.english: A widow to a High Priest - There is betrothal and there is a transgression, for he holds: Betrothal takes effect with those liable for [violating] negative commandments.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:16:1.english: The offspring is a mamzer - In the Gemara, [it] explains this.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:16:2.english: Of all the forbidden relations in the Torah - [Namely,] of those liable to excision.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:16:3.hebrew: הולד כמותה - ולד נכרית נכרי. ואם גיירוהו, הוי גר כשר ואינו ממזר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:16:3.english: The offspring is like her - The offspring of a gentile woman is a gentile. And if they convert him, he is a fit convert and is not a mamzer.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:16:4.hebrew: ולד שפחה - עבד ששחררו בעליו, כשר ומותר בישראלית:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:16:4.english: The offspring of a maidservant - A slave whose master emancipated him is fit and permitted to [marry] an Israelite woman.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:1:1.hebrew: מנא אמינא לה - דאין עד אחד נאמן בדבר ערוה לפסול, ואפילו אין לו מכחיש:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:1:1.english: From where do I say it - That a single witness is not believed in a matter of forbidden relations to disqualify [someone], even if he has no one contradicting him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:1:2.hebrew: מגורה - מגורת מים, כמין בריכות מים, כדאמר בבבא בתרא (דף סז.): לא מכר את המגורות של מים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:1:2.english: A reservoir - A water reservoir, a type of pool of water, as it says in Bava Batra (67a): "[He] did not sell the water reservoirs."

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:1:3.english: Of Diskim - The name of a person, or the name of a place in Yavne.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:1:4.english: In the presumptive status of being complete - [That it contained] forty se'ah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:2:1.hebrew: היה רבי טרפון מטהר - דאמר: השתא הוא דחסר, ובשעה שטבלו בה אדם וכלים, שלימה היתה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:2:1.english: Rabbi Tarfon would render [them] ritually pure - For he says: It is [only] now that it became deficient, and at the time that a person and utensils immersed in it, it was complete.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:2:2.hebrew: מטמא - דלא ידעינן מאימת חסרה, ונמצא שאינה טבילה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:2:2.english: Renders [them] impure - For we do not know from when it became deficient, and it turns out that it is not a [valid] immersion.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:3:1.hebrew: שעבודתו - שעבד כבר — כשירה. לקמן יליף לה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:3:1.english: That his service - [The service] that he already performed is valid. Later on, [the Gemara] derives this.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:3:2.hebrew: בעל מום שעבודתו - שעבד כבר — פסולה, ואפילו היה שוגג. לקמן יליף לה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:3:2.english: A blemished [priest], that his service - [That which] he already performed is disqualified, and even if he was unwitting. Later, [the Gemara] derives this.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:5:1.hebrew: מקוה פסולו ביחיד - בא אחד ואומר: "אני מדדתיו ונמצא חסר" — נאמן, דקי"ל (גיטין דף ב:) דעד אחד נאמן באיסורין:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:5:1.english: The disqualification of a ritual bath is by an individual - [If] one comes and says, "I measured it and it was found deficient," he is believed, as it is established for us (Gittin 2b) that a single witness is believed in matters of prohibition.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:5:2.hebrew: ובעל מום פסולו ביחיד - בא אחד ואמר: ״בעל מום הוא״ — נאמן, ולקמן מפרש לה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:5:2.english: And a blemished [priest], his disqualification is by an individual - [If] one came and said: “He is a blemished [priest],” he is believed; and later [the Gemara] explains it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:6:1.english: Due to others - On account of his mother.

Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:9:1.hebrew: שלח אחוי - אם אינך בעל מום, הפשט בגדיך ונראה. והיינו דקתני: ״בעל מום פסולו בגופו״ — שנוכל לברר הדברים, וכן מקוה — חסרונו לפנינו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 66b:9:1.english: Remove [your clothes and] show - If you are not a blemished [priest], strip off your clothes and we will see. And this is what [the baraita] teaches: “A blemished [priest], his disqualification is in his body” — that we are able to clarify the matter; and similarly a ritual bath, its deficiency is before us.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:10:1.hebrew: ולזרעו אחריו בין זרע כשר בין זרע פסול - ובריש מכילתין (דף ד.) אמר: "וזרע אין לה" — אין לי אלא זרע כשר, זרע פסול מנין? ת"ל וכו', משמע דלשון "זרע" לא משתמע אלא כשר. וי"ל, דשאני הכא ד"זרעו" מיותר, דהוה מצי למיכתב "ולבניו", שהרי בבנות לא שייך ברית כהונה, ולכך דרשינן מיניה אפילו זרע פסול; אבל התם אינו מיותר, שהרי התם יש לו בת כמו בן:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:10:1.english: “And to his seed after him” — whether fit seed or unfit seed - And at the beginning of our tractate (4a), [the Gemara] said: “And she has no seed” (Leviticus 22:13) — I have [derived] only fit seed; from where [do I derive that even] unfit seed [disqualifies her]? The verse states, etc., which implies that the term “seed” denotes only fit [offspring]. And it can be answered that here it is different, because “his seed” is superfluous, as [the verse] could have written “and to his sons,” since the covenant of priesthood does not apply to daughters; therefore, we derive from it even unfit seed. But there, it is not superfluous, for there, [having] a daughter is like [having] a son [in precluding her from eating teruma].

Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:14:1.hebrew: כל מקום שיש קידושין ויש כו' וכל מקום שאין קידושין ואיזה זה זה הבא על אחת מכל העריות שבתורה - נראה לר"י דהך סתמא אתיא כרבי שמעון התימני, דאמר בסוף פ' החולץ (יבמות מט.): "יש ממזר מחייבי כריתות ולא מחייבי לאוין", וכה"ג קאמר הכא. ועוד נראה לר"י דהלכה כי הך סתמא, אע"ג דאיכא סתמא אחרינא ביבמות (דף צב.) כר' עקיבא; מ"מ הך סתמא עיקר, משום דמתניא גבי הילכתא פסיקתא דקידושין. ועוד, דמצינו בהרבה מקומות כי האי סתמא, כדקתני התם (יבמות דף יד:): "פשיטא, בני חייבי לאוין כשרים נינהו!", ועוד תני: "איזהו ממזר? כל שאיסורו איסור ערוה וענוש כרת", משמע דלא הוי ממזר אלא מחייבי כריתות:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:14:1.english: "Any case where there is betrothal and there is, etc., and any case where there is no betrothal... and which is this? This is one who has relations with one of all the forbidden sexual relations in the Torah" - It appears to the Ri that this anonymous [Mishnah] follows Rabbi Shimon HaTeimani, who said at the end of the chapter [entitled] HaCholetz (Yevamot 49a): "There is a mamzer [only] from those liable to karet, but not from those liable to negative commandments"; and in this manner it states here. And furthermore, it appears to the Ri that the halakhah follows this anonymous [Mishnah], even though there is another anonymous [Mishnah] in Yevamot (92a) that follows Rabbi Akiva; nevertheless, this anonymous [Mishnah] is primary, because it is taught among the definitive halakhot of Kiddushin. And furthermore, we find in many places like this anonymous [Mishnah], as [the Gemara] teaches there (Yevamot 14b): "It is obvious! The children of those liable to negative commandments are fit [i.e., not mamzerim]!"; and furthermore it is taught: "Who is a mamzer? Anyone whose prohibition is the prohibition of an ervah (forbidden relation) and is punishable by karet" — which implies that one is not a mamzer except from those liable to karet.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:3:1.hebrew: אמר רבי טרפון משל לעומד ומקריב על גבי המזבח - וא"ת: מאי משל הוא זה? הרי במשל, אפי' נודע שפסול היה בשעת עבודה — אפ"ה עבודתו כשרה, כדמוכח בסמוך מקרא; ובכי האי גוונא גבי מקוה, אם נמצא שמדידתו היתה תחלה בטעות — טהרותיו טמאות למפרע, אפילו לר' טרפון! ואור"י, דבתרתי פליגי: פליגי בטהרות שנעשו על גביו למפרע — מר אזיל בתר חזקה דמקוה ומר אזיל בתר חזקה דאדם, ובשלא נודע חסרון המקוה למפרע; [ופליגי נמי בטמא שטבל במקוה, ולאחר זמן נודע שהיה חסר באותה שעה — שטהרותיו טהורות למפרע, ואהא מייתי המשל;] ופליגי נמי במקוה שטבל בה כהן ועבד עבודה, ובאו עדים והעידו שהיה המקוה חסר קודם הטבילה — רבי טרפון אומר: כשירה העבודה, מידי דהוה אבן גרושה ובן חלוצה; ואהא קאי המשל:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:3:1.english: Rabbi Tarfon said: A parable to one who stands and sacrifices on the altar - And if you will say: What kind of parable is this? For in the parable, even if it became known that he was invalid at the time of the service, nevertheless his service is valid, as is proven nearby from Scripture; whereas in a case of this kind regarding a ritual bath, if it is found that its measurement was initially in error, his purifications are retroactively ritually impure even according to Rabbi Tarfon! And Rabbeinu Yitzchak says that they dispute two [matters]: They dispute regarding purifications that were performed relying upon it retroactively — one Master goes after the presumptive status of the ritual bath, and one Master goes after the presumptive status of the person, and [this dispute applies] where the deficiency of the ritual bath retroactively was not known [for certain]; [and they also dispute regarding an impure person who immersed in a ritual bath, and after some time it became known that it was deficient at that time — that his purifications are retroactively pure, and regarding this he brings the parable;] and they also dispute regarding a ritual bath in which a priest immersed and performed the Temple service, and witnesses came and testified that the ritual bath had been deficient prior to the immersion — Rabbi Tarfon says: The service is valid, just as it is in the case of the son of a divorced woman and the son of a ḥalutza; and it is upon this that the parable is based.

Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:9:1.hebrew: שלח ואחוי - תרגום של "והפשיט" — "ושלח" (ויקרא א). מכאן יש להוכיח, דכל דבר שיכול להתברר — עד א' נאמן עליו, ואפילו עד א' מכחישו:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 66b:9:1.english: "Strip and show" - [This is the Aramaic] translation of vehifshit [and he shall flay]: "ushlaḥ" (Leviticus 1). From here there is proof that [regarding] anything that can be clarified, a single witness is believed about it, and even if a single witness contradicts him.
